hardware: Apple M4 Max, 48 GiB unified memory
protocol: Fresh Metal HTTP server per row and one common 8/8 warmup. One uncached greedy request, seed 42, ignore EOS, 64 output IDs. TTFT and first-to-last decode TPS are client measurements. Total time includes the end of stream. Read variants use the same binary. The large-range reader validates all shards before and after each contiguous range and uses positioned reads of up to 64 MiB. Short prompts have the same IDs in both modes. OS cache uncontrolled. One observation per condition. Process disk byte deltas use macOS proc_pid_rusage around POST, first SSE token and end of stream; these client boundaries can include in-flight work.
decode_method: Temporary separately linked server uses the engine profiler from sampling output 1 until sampling output 64. Counter differences cover the 63 decode intervals. Projection is inclusive. GPU service overlaps host work. Completion wait is host waiting for Metal. Queue wait is nested in acquire/read. The wall remainder outside timed expert projections includes the ordinary graph, routing, sampling and server work.

decode_detail.method: Separate intrusive trace of 63 decode steps, one server per cap. Per-layer timings are nested CPU wall times in the MoE pipeline. Count only fresh expert projection slices returned by a demand group whose consumer actually waited. Multiple slices may complete in one group. Its wait cannot be assigned to any single expert. The queue wait sum is checked against the independent cumulative timer. Do not use trace timing for client TPS comparisons.

decisions.reader: Keep the checked batched reader as the default. The candidate lost both TTFT and weight wait in the first 8 GiB pair; no reverse or expanded sweep was warranted.
decisions.short_prompt: Keep the current admission threshold. Both 32-token fixtures were faster on the narrow path but changed greedy output at positions 11 (library) and 16 (dispatch) at both caps. The 128-token wide path won in both fixtures at both caps and matched all 64 IDs. No change was eligible for the intermediate budgets.
decisions.decode: The largest separately reported host phase was expert acquisition. Follow-up traced which groups returned from blocking waits. Layers 0 and 28 ranked first and second at both caps. A timed group can contain multiple projections and experts. Its delay does not identify a single responsible expert.
